option.value: Avoid overly verbose descriptions or unnecessary details. Use the Conventional Commit Format.

list.name: Changes
list.comment:
fix(layout): add input validation and fix UI layout inconsistencies
- Added hex string validation to `hexToHslString` to prevent crashes on malformed inputs. - Fixed viewport and scrolling issues by updating layout classes (`min-h-screen` -> `h-screen`, added `overflow-hidden`). - Ensured consistent sidebar and mobile nav behavior (`h-full`, `shrink-0`, pinned elements).

task.summary: Default task

feat(ui): refactor components for consistent theming and improve accessibility
- Standardized colors and styles across components for better theme consistency. - Updated `LoginPage`, `DiscoverClient`, and `TenantMemberSidebar` with accessible text and color contrast. - Refactored UI elements (e.g., buttons, badges, headers) to use scalable, reusable classes. - Enhanced layout alignment and spacing for smoother responsive design.

feat(auth): refactor login page with interactive forms and improved error handling
- Migrated to client-side rendering with React state for better interactivity. - Implemented dynamic form validation and error messages for login and Google sign-in. - Redesigned UI for enhanced branding and responsive usability. - Configured experimental Next.js features for local dev origins.

feat(ui): add customizable `Select` component with enhanced accessibility and theming
- Implemented a reusable and modular `Select` component leveraging `@base-ui/react/select`. - Added support for customization of triggers, labels, groups, items, and separators. - Enhanced keyboard navigation and screen reader support for improved accessibility. - Integrated consistent theming with utility classes and dark mode support.

feat(dashboard): refactor tenant URL generation logic for improved readability and flexibility
- Replaced hardcoded URLs with a dynamic `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` environment variable. - Updated URL construction for admin console links to use `URL` object.

feat(dashboard): add subdomain extraction logic for tenant identification
- Implemented fallback logic to extract active subdomain from `window.location.hostname` for multi-tenant support. - Ensures compatibility with subdomain isolation setups excluding localhost.

feat(tenants): refactor multi-tenant layout and improve routing logic
- Merged `[subdomain]` and generic tenant layouts into a unified structure for better maintainability. - Refactored tenant routing to dynamically generate exploration and login URLs based on environment. - Simplified component structure for sidebar and main content rendering with clear isolation. - Enhanced UI transitions with new animations for smoother rendering.
refactor(tenants): move tenant layout to subdomain-specific folder for better structure

feat(auth): update baseURL and trusted origins for enhanced flexibility and local development support
- Refactored `baseURL` to support multiple hosts with protocol and fallback configurations. - Updated `trustedOrigins` to include localhost and wildcard subdomains for local testing.

feat(auth): enhance cookie handling and domain logic for improved flexibility
- Made `useSecureCookies` environment-dependent for better local and production compatibility. - Refactored `crossSubDomainCookies` and `defaultCookieAttributes` to dynamically set domains and secure attributes based on environment.

feat(auth): refactor environment-dependent logic for baseURL, cookies, and IDs
- Refactored `baseURL` to dynamically select production or development configurations. - Simplified UUID generation in database hooks for users, sessions, and accounts. - Enhanced cookie management with environment-aware settings for security and cross-domain compatibility.

feat(auth): update `redirect` logic to use dynamic environment-based root domain
- Refactored `layout.tsx` to dynamically configure `rootDomain` using `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` for production and localhost for development.
fix(proxy): add production domain to hostname check
fix(proxy): add production domain to hostname check
fix(proxy): add production domain to hostname check
refactor(auth): remove redundant comments in baseURL logic
refactor(auth): remove redundant comments in baseURL logic
refactor(proxy): exclude `/login` from proxy matcher configuration
refactor(proxy): exclude `/login` from proxy matcher configuration

refactor(proxy): update matcher logic to exclude `/login` and `/dashboard` paths
- Broadened internal asset guards to bypass additional routes from custom re-writes. - Updated hostname handling for consistency across local and production environments.

refactor(proxy): adjust matcher configuration and update internal workspace changes
- Migrated `/auth` pages to a simplified folder structure for better routing organization. - Updated IntelliJ workspace files to reflect recent task history and cached file changes.

refactor(dashboard): remove unused client components for dashboard and gym discovery
- Deleted `dashboardClient.tsx` and `discoverClient.tsx` to clean up unused code and improve project structure.

feat(settings): add settings and dashboard client components
- Introduced `settingsClient.tsx` for profile and settings management. - Added `dashboardClient.tsx` for tenant-specific dashboard functionalities. - Implemented secure API integrations for user profile, avatar upload, and password updates. - Enhanced gym onboarding flow with subdomain and tenant validation.

fix(domain): update domain references from `stride.lk` to `dsmhgroup.com`
- Replaced all URL references to use the new production domain `dsmhgroup.com`. - Updated client-side redirection logic, tenant subdomains, and related UI elements.
fix(auth): update login redirect to use HTTPS

fix(proxy): simplify subdomain extraction logic and update link path
- Adjusted logic to handle subdomains with fewer conditional checks. - Fixed incorrect support link path in the dashboard component.

fix(proxy): update dashboard link to use custom domain
- Replaced subdomain logic for generating admin URLs, switching from `slug` to `domain`.

fix(proxy): add debug logging for profile fetch in admin console
- Introduced temporary debug logging to inspect profile matrix output. - Adjusted JSON parsing logic in `consoleClient.tsx`.

fix(proxy): add CORS headers for `/api/auth` to handle cross-origin requests
- Implemented CORS headers to explicitly allow subdomains of `dsmhgroup.com`. - Ensured compatibility for cross-origin API authentication requests.

fix(proxy): add CORS headers for `/api/auth` to handle cross-origin requests
- Implemented CORS headers to explicitly allow subdomains of `dsmhgroup.com`. - Ensured compatibility for cross-origin API authentication requests.

fix(consoleClient): update membership lookup to use `domain` instead of `slug`
- Adjusted logic to prioritize `domain` for tenant matching in `consoleClient.tsx`. - Updated IntelliJ workspace with recent task history changes.

fix(membership): adjust server fetch for role lookup with safer headers handling
- Updated `membership.ts` to use `next/headers` for secure cookie and tenant ID forwarding. - Simplified conditional rendering in `TenantSidebarManager.tsx` for better readability.

fix(membership): improve membership role resolution logic
- Refactored `membership.ts` to isolate and match active tenant membership accurately. - Enhanced error handling and added debug logging for missing memberships. - Simplified role extraction for better maintainability.

fix(proxy): enhance tenant routing and logging for improved debugging
- Added detailed trace logging to improve visibility in the routing pipeline. - Adjusted internal asset guard conditions and streamlined subdomain detection logic. - Enhanced handling of CORS headers for `/api/auth` requests with stricter evaluation of allowed origins. - Improved backend resolution error handling and tenant metadata parsing. - Refined routing rewrite behavior for tenant-specific paths.

feat(members): implement live member roster sync and invitation workflow
- Integrated live data fetching with `react-query` for tenant membership roster. - Added secure member invitation workflow with email and phone input support. - Enhanced filtering, search, and display logic for dynamic roster management. - Improved UX/UI with loading, error handling, and KPI summary enhancements.

feat(dialog): add accessible and customizable dialog component
- Introduced a new `Dialog` component with full accessibility using `@base-ui/react/dialog`. - Added support for customizable overlays, headers, footers, and close buttons. - Improved usability with slot-based architecture and utility-first styling.

refactor(members): simplify `MembersPage` by removing unused server-side logic
- Removed redundant `fetchTenantMembers` and interface definitions. - Refactored `MembersPage` to rely on `tenantId` header directly for client-side handling.

feat(invites): add pending invites management and UI integration
- Built `InvitesPage` with server-side handling of tenant data. - Created `InvitesClient` for managing pending invites using `react-query`. - Added UI for viewing, resending, and revoking invitations within the admin panel. - Updated sidebar to include an "Invites" section for improved navigation.

feat(register): redesign registration form with invitation flow support
- Simplified and modernized `RegisterForm` UI for a better user experience. - Added support for workspace invitations, including pre-filled email fields and redirection to tenant-specific domains. - Integrated `toast` notifications for error and success feedback during registration. - Optimized form logic to remove unnecessary steps and improve onboarding efficiency. - Introduced `Suspense` wrapper for improved client search parameter handling.

feat(invites): add copy magic link functionality to admin invites panel
- Introduced new "Copy Magic Link" button for generating and copying magic links to the clipboard. - Implemented toast notifications for success or failure when copying the link. - Enhanced user experience with quick access to shareable invitation links via the admin panel.

feat(invites): add copy magic link functionality to admin invites panel
- Introduced new "Copy Magic Link" button for generating and copying magic links to the clipboard. - Implemented toast notifications for success or failure when copying the link. - Enhanced user experience with quick access to shareable invitation links via the admin panel.

feat(dashboard): implement workspace grid and athlete metrics components
- Added `WorkspaceGrid` for displaying user workspaces with role-specific actions. - Introduced `AthleteMetrics` for tracking attendance, personal records, and weekly performance. - Updated global dashboard page with role-based workspace management and metric insights. - Refactored `dashboardClient` to modularize components and simplify state handling.
fix(dashboard): update user profile endpoint in `dashboardClient` for data consistency

feat(sidebar): refactor `TenantSidebarManager` with unified role-based navigation
- Introduced `getRoleConfig` for centralized role-based navigation configuration. - Replaced individual role-specific sidebars with a unified `UnifiedSidebar` component. - Improved code readability and maintainability by reducing duplication. - Added support for badge notifications and simplified error and loading states. - Enhanced user experience with dynamic role-based themes and streamlined API calls.

fix(layout): add input validation and fix UI layout inconsistencies
- Added hex string validation to `hexToHslString` to prevent crashes on malformed inputs. - Fixed viewport and scrolling issues by updating layout classes (`min-h-screen` -> `h-screen`, added `overflow-hidden`). - Ensured consistent sidebar and mobile nav behavior (`h-full`, `shrink-0`, pinned elements).
